description:
M22 final release acceptance: Research Validation Agent (11.3). Owner explicitly approved role-specific final review and actual terminal interaction. This is a NEW bounded acceptance task, not replay of a failed prior task.

Read project AGENTS.md, docs/m22-acceptance-contract.md, docs/validation/m21-release-hardening.md, and your exact role mandate. Review existing implementation against one concrete requirement and one failure case relevant to your role. No source or unrelated file edits. Only create your exclusive contribution artifact at C:/Users/Jonat/algoalpha/projects/quant-terminal/docs/agent-contributions/11-3.md and a same-stem .json evidence file. No delegation, no new tasks, no orders, external broker connections, paid services, secret reads or changes to runtime/source.

Actually interact with the trusted frozen terminal at http://127.0.0.1:8765 using GET /health, GET /runs, and GET /runs/<run_id> for the returned synthetic run. Inspect its manifest/metrics for your role, including unavailable benchmark/insufficient-sample caveats. Store timestamp, requested method/URL, response status and SHA256 of exact response bytes, selected actual run_id and Paperclip run/issue IDs from your task context (not invented). Store clear role-specific finding with observed evidence and limitation, required failure case and whether observed implementation satisfies it. A synthetic Sharpe does not prove alpha or justify capital allocation. HTTP success alone is not acceptance.

Use Python urllib.request or PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest for actual requests. Record failures truthfully; do not claim M16 or final release passed. Mark this issue done only if artifact and real terminal interaction evidence exist; otherwise report concrete blockage on this issue. Preserve all existing artifacts.

Role build scope: Independently review fixtures and evidence for leakage, accounting, robustness or governance according to your role. Do not approve your own implementation.
Role interaction scope: Rerun an approved synthetic experiment or inspect its immutable artifacts, then record a traceable challenge.
Role mandate:
11.3 Research Validation Agent

Mandate: Verify the methodological integrity and reproducibility of quantitative research.

Responsibilities: Review research hypotheses, data selection, statistical calculations and model documentation; reproduce material findings; confirm temporal validity; and examine the relationship between reported results and supporting evidence.

Deliverables: Research validation reports, methodological exception logs and validation recommendations.

KPIs: Validation coverage, reproducibility and identification of material research defects.
